name: rx5500xt
description: AMD Radeon RX 5500 XT (Navi 14, RDNA 1, gfx1012) at its 1845 MHz clock: one Vortex core per CU; the CU is RDNA 2's (rx6600).

sources.CU (other core knobs): Inherited from rx6600: RDNA 1 and RDNA 2 share the CU (2 SIMD32 with their own schedulers, 16 KB L0 vector cache, 64 KB LDS, FP64 at 1/16)
sources.EXT_RTU_ENABLE: Off: RDNA 1 has no ray accelerators
sources.NUM_CORES: 22 CUs (11 DCUs), 1408 stream processors (Bao et al., NaviSim: A Highly Accurate GPU Simulator for AMD RDNA GPUs (PACT 2022), Table 1; RX 5500 XT specifications)
sources.L2_SIZE, L2_NUM_WAYS, L3_ENABLE: 1 MB 16-way L2 (Bao et al., NaviSim: A Highly Accurate GPU Simulator for AMD RDNA GPUs (PACT 2022), Table 2) and no Infinity Cache, which came with RDNA 2
sources.PLATFORM_MEMORY_TYPE, PLATFORM_MEMORY_NU: Inherited from rx6600: 128-bit GDDR6 at 14 Gbps, 8 x16 channels, 224 GB/s (Bao et al., NaviSim: A Highly Accurate GPU Simulator for AMD RDNA GPUs (PACT 2022), Table 1)
sources.PLATFORM_CLOCK_RATE: 1845 MHz, the core clock NaviSim validates at (Bao et al., NaviSim: A Highly Accurate GPU Simulator for AMD RDNA GPUs (PACT 2022), Table 1)
sources.reference: fp32_lanes is the vendor FP32 core count (FP32 FMA lanes per chip, clock-free); dram_bandwidth_gbs the vendor peak. Checked by ci/profile_check.py. NaviSim validates its RDNA model against this card; its pointer chase puts the first-level (L0) cache near 110 cycles (Bao et al., NaviSim: A Highly Accurate GPU Simulator for AMD RDNA GPUs (PACT 2022), Figure 1), read off a chart, so the chase metrics are unchecked
